name: YFY Inc.
summary: YFY Inc., an investment holding company, manufactures and sells paper and paper-related products in Taiwan. It provides forest, fine paper, and board products; industrial paper and paper containers, such as kraft paper and corrugated paper, corrugated cardboard boxes, corrugated cardboard, colored cardboard boxes and containers, food containers, paper pallet; and household paper and tissue paper under the Mayflower, Tender, and Delight brands.
